title: Colorful Crafting
description: Redye Candles and Banners using any dye + craft Mossy block variants of stairs, slabs, and walls!
body:
### ◆ Colorful Crafting - - - ### What does this datapack do? Colorful Crafting adds a splash of color to crafting recipes, adding additional crafting recipes not present in Vanilla. Redye banners and candles, and boost your building with recipes that make crafting Mossy Cobblestone or Stone Brick block variants. - - - ### How does this work? The recipe unlock system in this datapack functions indentical to Vanilla. Picking up a colored dye, a moss block, or vines, will unlock the recipes. - - - Includes: - Crafting recipes for redyeing Banners and Candles using any colored dye - Crafting recipes for Mossy Cobblestone + Stone Brick Stairs, Slabs, and Walls - Crafting recipe for smelting Stone Slabs into Smooth Stone Slabs - - - ![Redye any colored banner and or candle using any colored dye!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4158df4b6f7be8c6b2e466db21da04d7f32d8d13.gif)
![Craft mossy block variants using any stair, slab, or wall!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1a77cc4a560973fdeb1ce680b83ee6514b989cb.gif)
